occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: Grass has grown high in the use fill areas along with plants along the wall of play yard and in cracks of cement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: Recalled Product Certification page was out of date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §746.801(18))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Following items were in need of repair or non functioning:    Sink in infant room non functioning.  one of the four sinks in mens rooms not functioning.    Toilet tank cover missing on one toilet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides: Two slides in the play yard did not have the proper use zones.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregiver did not know the age range of the children in her care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary: Two cartons of instant potations were expired in the pantry.  The stove had uncovered fish sticks on the range top.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Safe and Sanitary (26 TAC §746.3317)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: Ceiling tile was damaged and removed, exposing ceiling.  Fence repair out in play yard has large gaps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: There is various garbage and a bag of garbage out in the play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: Child was observed using a cellphone while in nap time cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Licensed Operations Required Fees: Our system is showing that background check fees for $8 and $4 has not been paid.This was corrected during inspection when director paid the fees online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensed Operations Required Fees (26 TAC §745.509)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding sheet for one child was not updated for the month of November 2025. The last update was in October.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes: There was no daily infant report for one infant. Child was not at the operation during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Daily Report - Times of Diaper Changes (26 TAC §746.2431(3))

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: The infant room was absent of any caregiver when the children were observed napping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four children records did not have a listed emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Education Outside of U.S.: Caregiver did not have a translated proof of education requirement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Education Outside of U.S. (26 TAC §746.1111)

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Notify Parent in Writing within 14 Days if no longer carrying Insurance: Parents have not been notified within 14 days of the expiration of liability insurance as of 3/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - Notify Parent in Writing within 14 Days if no longer carrying Insurance (26 TAC §746.207(b))

occurrences.finding: Crib Activities: Children were left in their cribs after awakening for more than 30 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Crib Activities (26 TAC §746.2425)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two child records did not have the name of the school being attended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Seven child records did not have the information for their doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: The infant room was pitch dark when entered and observed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Director Certificate Not Renewed: Director has not produced the proper credentials to renew their director's certification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Certificate Not Renewed (26 TAC §746.1057)

occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: Operation has not reported their staffing changes for the year 2024 by the due date of 1/15/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: I observed children younger than two years old doing screen time. This was corrected when music was turned on instead of screen time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions for one infant was not available.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: Operation did not have the current fire inspection available. Operation has paid for the inspection and director stated that fire inspection will be conducted on Monday.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The grass in the outdoor area needed to be cut and the playground also needed to be cleaned. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Doctor's information was missing on file for one out of six files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The black band by the wall in the two to three years old classroom is falling off the wall. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth: Outdoor use zone needed more mulch.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - height=depth (26 TAC §746.4901(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Emergency Medical Authorization was missing on one file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission: Date of admission was missing on file for one out of six files checked. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Date of Admission (26 TAC §746.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: First aid and CPR training was missing in one out of four files checked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There were some nails on the bench by the fence which needed to be removed. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two out of five infants on the table high chair did not have their safety straps on. This was corrected during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A caregiver responsible for the school age children (ages 4y-12y) did not state the correct number of children they are responsible for. The caregiver stated there are 18 children present. There were 17 children currently present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: A 5 year old child was observed in the infant room with children between the ages of 12 months and 22 months. The 5 year old child was observed playing on the floor in the infant classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There is a part of the playground fence that is broken and has a space large enough for children to exit the playground where other businesses are located in the strip center and also to allow someone to easily access the operation's playground or the operation's back door to enter into the building. There are also two parts of the playground fence that contains large spaces large enough for a small child to exit the playground.     A photo was taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The changing pad in the infant room contains rips/tears in it.     Also, one of the doors to the infant room are broken. There are five commercial food cans sitting on the floor against the door to keep it from failing.     Also, the toilet of the 2nd stall in the girls restroom does not work. It has a sign on the toilet seat that states "do not use".     Photos were taken of the following.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: There is no documentation of severe weather drills practiced at least four times a year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Handwashing Procedures: There is no soap or paper towels in neither the boys and girls restrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Handwashing Procedures (26 TAC §746.3419)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: A bottle for an infant in care was not labeled with the child's first and last name.     Note: The child's bottle was labeled with the child's name during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A caregiver responsible for the school age children (ages 4y-12y) did not state the correct number of children they are responsible for. The caregiver stated there are 18 children present. There were 19 children currently present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly: The center is not well ventilated with air conditioning. The thermostat inside the school age room and where the children eat read 81 degrees and the thermostat inside the preschool room read 82 degrees. There were no children observed in the preschool room during the inspection. The preschool children were utilizing another room where air conditioning was.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Center Heated, Lighted and Ventilated Properly (26 TAC §746.3407(10))
